project_name: Adams County Data Center near Stuart Substation
status_detail: WCPO reports a Feb. 3 AES Ohio/PJM regulatory filing for a data center customer near the former Stuart power plant/substation in Adams County, ramping from 100 MW in 2028 to 1.3 GW by March 2032. Ohio EPA records also indicated 12 light-industrial buildings at the former Dayton Power & Light landfill site; Sprigg Township later passed a 12-month data-center moratorium after public pushback.
notes: Developer/operator not publicly named in accessible reporting; possible site described as former Carter Hollow/Buck Canyon/DP&L landfill north of Stuart. Status treated as planned/early-stage, with local moratorium risk.
